sum_insured_options: Global SI: USD 1.5L / 2.5L / 5L / 7.5L / 10L; India Cover (optional): INR 1.5Cr / 2.5Cr / 4.5Cr / 6.5Cr / Unlimited

room_rent.note: India Cover: any room category at actuals. Global Cover: no room sub-limit stated.

icu.note: ICU charges not proportionately reduced; covered at actuals within SI.

copayment.note: 20% co-pay on assessed claim if insured (or eldest in floater) is aged 61+ at first policy inception. Waiver of co-pay available as optional add-on (3.3.1). Dental cover has mandatory 20% co-pay regardless of age.

sub_limits.display: Gene Therapy sub-limited; most covers at SI
sub_limits.note: Elite plan covers only Specified Illnesses (Cancer, CABG, Heart Valve, Neurosurgery, Organ Transplant, Bone Marrow, Aorta Graft, Pulmonary Graft, Skin Grafting, Joint Replacement, Reconstructive Surgery, Gene Therapy). Gene Therapy: 50% of Global SI or USD 5L whichever lower; lifetime 100% of Global SI. India Cover (if opted): Gene Therapy 50% of India Base SI; OPD INR 50k; Medical Equipment DME INR 5L, SME INR 2L; Home Care INR 25L; Rehabilitation INR 50k.

initial_waiting.note: Global Cover: 90-day initial waiting period for illness. India Cover: 30-day initial waiting period. Both waived for accidents.

ped_waiting.display: 36 months (reducible to 12 mo via optional add-on)
ped_waiting.note: Default PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional add-on (3.3.3) allows reduction to 24 or 12 months at additional premium.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions (ENT, gynaecological, orthopaedic, GI, urogenital, eye, benign tumours etc.). Joint replacement has 36-month wait.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% of India Base SI (25%/yr)
cumulative_bonus.note: Applicable to India Cover only. 25% of India Base SI added per claim-free year; max 100%. Reduces by 25% in a claim year. Not applicable for Unlimited India Base SI option.

restoration.note: India Cover: Unlimited Reinstatement of India Base SI after each claim settlement, for both related and unrelated illness/injury. Activated only after India Base SI + NCB + Inflation Protection exhausted. Not applicable for Unlimited India Base SI option.

pre_hosp.note: Global Cover: from date of arrival in city of treatment up to 15 days. India Cover: 90 days pre-hospitalisation.

post_hosp.note: Global Cover: 30 days post-discharge. India Cover: 180 days post-discharge.

day_care.display: All day-care (India Cover); Pre/Post-operative day care (Global Cover)

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered under India Cover within SI. Excludes listed conditions (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy etc.). Global Cover does not cover domiciliary.

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (India Cover only)
ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered under India Cover within India Base SI. Not applicable under Global Cover.

organ_donor.display: Covered (India Cover within SI; Global Cover within Global SI)
organ_donor.note: India Cover: organ donor in-patient expenses covered within SI. Global Cover: donor expenses during transplant covered within Global SI.

ambulance.note: India Cover: Domestic road ambulance and air ambulance covered within SI (intercity extended limit per schedule). Global Cover: ambulance included in in-patient treatment within Global SI.

modern_treatments.note: India Cover: 9 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, stereotactic radio surgery, etc.) covered within SI. Global Cover: covered as part of in-patient treatment for specified illnesses.

consumables.display: Covered (listed consumables in Annexure A-List I)
consumables.note: India Cover: consumables listed in Annexure A-List I covered when prescribed and medically necessary for in-patient/day care treatment. Non-listed consumables excluded.

global_cover.note: Global Cover is the primary/mandatory section covering planned treatment abroad for Specified Illnesses only (Elite plan). Cashless via empanelled service providers. Covers USA, UK, Germany, Switzerland, France and other countries.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except for established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/quarterly/half-yearly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, fertility/IVF, hazardous sports (professional), sleep apnea, external congenital anomaly, hormone replacement therapy, peritoneal dialysis, treatment in India (Global Cover), treatment abroad (India Cover)
optional_riders: Waiver of Co-Payment (age 61+), Voluntary Co-Payment (10%/20% discount), Reduced PED Waiting Period (36→24 or 12 months), India Cover (optional add-on to Global Cover)
